Expression of Interest (EOI):    

  Cardiologists to provide Virtual Cardiac Care for Northern Territory: A Unique Opportunity    

   

 NT Cardiac is a private cardiac specialist practice which has been providing diagnostic and consultative services to both public and private patients over 25 years.  We have a well-established local infrastructure, diagnostic capability and IT infrastructure to enable Virtual cardiac care.  Given the increasing demand, we have successfully piloted remotely supported clinic and diagnostic reporting by cardiologists based in other states of Australia.  Based on this success, we are looking to expand this model of care to support patients from all over the Northern Territory including Aboriginal patients from remote communities. 

   

 NT Cardiac is seeking of Expression of Interest from Cardiologists interested in providing   Virtual Cardiac Care   to both private and public patients across the Northern Territory. This role allows cardiologists to work remotely from their current base locations, leveraging on digital health platforms to deliver high-quality, patient-centred cardiac care across the NT. 

   

 This model of care is ideal for cardiologists who are committed to improving access to specialist services in regional and remote Australia with a keen interest in Aboriginal heart health, and who are comfortable using virtual systems to deliver clinical care. 

   

  About the Role  

 
	 Patient-focused cardiac services, including imaging and diagnostic solutions. 
	 Access to state-of-the-art equipment and facilities. 
	 Supportive team including dedicated admin staff for local support and coordination, nurses, experienced diagnostic technicians, cardiac sonographers. 
	 NT resident cardiologists will provide support and assistance for patients needing urgent face to face consultations or investigations. 
	 Supported with secure access to the following digital platforms:
	 
		  Coviuu or TEAMS  for Telehealth Consultation 
		  Aura Portal  &  VIP.Net-  NT Cardiac’s Patient Management System for scheduling, referrals, and reporting. 
		  HeartLab  – for reviewing and reporting on echocardiograms. 
		  Epiphany  – for access and interpretation of ECGs, Holters, BPM results. 
		  Synapse access to  Radiology images 
	 
	 
	 Flexible or sessional arrangements working arrangements, including after hours. 
	 Competitive remuneration (negotiable) 
 

   

  Key Responsibilities  

 
	 Provide virtual consultation and diagnostic interpretation for referred patients. 
	 Refer, review and report on echocardiograms, ECGs, Holters and other investigations as required. 
	 Liaise with referring clinicians and NT Cardiac team to ensure continuity and quality of care.  
	 Maintain accurate and timely clinical documentation via the Aura Portal / Practice Management System. 
 

   

  Requirements  

 
	 Fellowship of the Royal Australasian College of Physicians (FRACP) in Cardiology or equivalent. 
	 Current specialist registration with AHPRA. 
	 Demonstrated experience in delivering high-quali    Apply Now

General Practitioner (GP) — Contract Opportunity Across Australia 

 Join a dynamic HealthTech startup and wellness centre delivering modern, patient-centred primary care through blended in-person and telehealth services. We are seeking experienced General Practitioners with full Australian registration and residency or citizenship to work on a contract basis across Australia. This role offers flexibility, strong professional support, and competitive billings-based pay of  65%–70% on billings . 

 What You’ll Do 

 
	 Provide high-quality general practice consultations to diverse adult and family populations via telehealth and in-clinic sessions. 
	 Deliver comprehensive assessments, diagnosis, management plans, acute care and chronic disease management in line with best practice guidelines. 
	 Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team including allied health, mental health clinicians, and digital health specialists to coordinate patient care. 
	 Use the HealthTech platform to document encounters, follow up results, prescribe and refer, and support continuity of care. 
	 Participate in targeted quality improvement projects, remote case reviews, and virtual clinical governance meetings. 
 

 Who You Are 

 
	 Registered with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA) as a General Practitioner. 
	 Australian citizen or permanent resident eligible to work across Australian states and territories. 
	 Experienced in general practice or family medicine with strong clinical decision-making and communication skills. 
	 Comfortable with telehealth platforms and digital patient records, plus the ability to balance virtual and face-to-face consultations. 
	 Committed to delivering patient-centred, evidence-based care with cultural sensitivity and respect for diverse communities. 
 

 Why Join Us 

 
	  Flexible hours:  Design a schedule that fits your lifestyle, with options for part-time or concentrated clinic blocks. 
	  Professional development:  Training provided, access to clinical upskilling, peer review, and mentorship within a growing HealthTech practice. 
	  Attractive earnings:  Competitive percentage on billings between 65% and 70% with transparent revenue sharing. 
	  Innovative environment:  Work with cutting-edge digital tools, telehealth infrastructure, and a mission-driven team focused on accessible care. 
	  Nationwide opportunities:  Contract roles available across Australia, enabling a range of practice locations and patient communities. 
 

  Ideal Candidates  

 We welcome applications from: 

 
	 GP Registrars 
	 VR GPs 
	 Non-VR GPs 
	 Doctors with previous telehealth experience 
	 Doctors seeking flexible work-from-home arrangements 
 

 Start Timeframe and Contract Details 

 Positions begin from a fixed date with contract terms tailored to clinician preference and site needs. This role is ideal for GPs seeking contractual flexibility while maintaining clinical excellence and continuity of care. The working arrangement supports clinicians who value autonomy and modern practice models. 

 Equal Opportunity
